BoolProperty.Name: UseLumaDXP
BoolProperty.Description: Enables the DXP shader patching SDK (vcpkg dependency, dxpatcher.lib, dxcompiler.dll runtime).

BoolProperty.Name: UseLumaNGX
BoolProperty.Description: Links NVIDIA NGX/DLSS and includes nvngx_dlss.dll in the package.

BoolProperty.Name: UseLumaFSR
BoolProperty.Description: Links AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution libraries.

BoolProperty.Name: UseLumaFastNoise
BoolProperty.Description: Compiles the FAST noise texture loader and packages the project-wide Global/Textures/FAST frames.

BoolProperty.Name: LumaPackage
BoolProperty.Description: Runs scripts/package.ps1 after the build, producing the release zip (addon + shaders + textures + runtime DLLs) into the repo's out_package folder.
